tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi thugs dam mchod rten bkra shis sgo mang gi nang gi dkar chag bzhugs so/// bde chen kun bzang yangs pa'i mdzod// bde skyid thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// bdag nyid gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// thugs dam bkra shis sgo mang 'jig rten gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba 'di nyid/ dkar chag chen mo'i lugs bzhin/ sbrul lo hor zla gsum pa'i tshes nyer gcig la/ 'phrod sbyor bzang po'i nyin par bzo thab btsugs nas/ bya lo hor zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer bzhi phan la lo hril po bzhi dang zla ba lnga song ba la/ sgo mang gi bzo spras/ chos skyong bang rim gyi lugs sku/ rgyal chen bzhi dang bcas pa grub/ tshes lnga'i nyin/ gza' skar dus sbyor bzang ba dang bstun/ thog mar dri bzang gi chus sbangs ba'i sa phag khad snyoms par bsgrigs pa'i rin chen sa stegs mtho dma' 'tsham pa'i steng du/ rdo rje'i 'jim pa dang bzang drug gi lde gus byugs te/ zhal zhal legs par byas/ klu'i sde tshan la phan pa'i sman sogs kyang tshang bar byugs pa'i steng du/ 'og gzhi rdo rje rgya gram gyi thig rat+na tsār+ya'i mchod rten dang mthun par btab pa'i steng du/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i rgyong shing spang leb khod snyoms par bsgrigs pa la/ zangs gser las grub pa'i dbus sna tshogs rdo rje'i mtha' skor la rdo rje'i ra bas bskor ba'i steng du/ ras dkar po dri ma med pa dri bzang gi chu dang*/ sman sna'i lde gus byugs te mtshams med par byas pa'i steng du/ bkra shis pa'i kha btags dkar po la chos kyi 'khor lo mtshan nyid dang mthun pa/ zur bzhi rin po che gser gyi bsdams pa'i steng*/ rgyu bzang ba'i shing las grub pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po ār+ya dzaṃ bha la yab yum/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i steng du/

gnod sbyin gtso bo brgyad yum dang bcas pa/ rgyu phun sum tshogs pa tsan dan la sogs pa'i pho shing mo shing la/ sku shin tu legs par bris te/ gzhan lugs la u rub dang zhabs rub sogs 'dug kyang 'dir rang bzhed la/ stod smad dang g.yas g.yon sku lus kyi cha la gzur thabs med par zhal sprod du bzhugs pa dkar gsum mngar gsum/ dri bzang la sogs kyis bsdams/ de'i phyi rol dang zur mtshams thams cad la/ rin po che dang sman gyi lde gus srubs med par byugs/ rgya nag gi pho brang nang nas bud pa'i kha btags ljang khra/ dmar khra/ ser khra/ sngo khra/ dkar khra la sogs tshon sna lnga kha tshang ba'i sku re la na bza' cha tshang*/ tshon sna lnga'i sku rags dang bcas pas legs par dkris te bzhugs pa'i steng nas/ thog phibs pa'i tshul du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa/ de gnyis kyi bar mtshams kyi 'khor yug sba dang smyug ma las grub pas bskor ba'i logs thams cad la bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad tshang ba/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad ka bas bteg pa/ gnod sbyin yab yum gyi thugs ka'i dzaṃ baṃ gyi sa bon dang pad+ma/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi mu khyud la 'dod gsol dang dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge/ ye dharmaḥ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi rnam 'phrul/ 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyi phyag len zhal shes dang mthun par gser dngul gyi bris pa/ de'i nang gnod sbyin gtso bo'i mdun du/ chu zangs las grub pa'i gter gyi bum pa mtshan nyid tshang ba'i nang du/ chu shel gyi bum pa mtho dma' 'khyud gang ba mtshan nyid tshang ba'i nang du/ rin po che pad+ma rā ga tshad bya ma gsar gyi sgo nga las ma chung ba/ yang rin po che rdo rje pha lam kha dog sna lnga rdzogs pa/ phra sbom byis pa gzhon nu'i mdzub mo tsam/ gzugs mo byi thur gyis dbyibs can/ gzhan yang in+d+ra nī la/ mar gad/ khyung skyugs/ nīl sogs rin po che'i rigs kyi legs par gang ba/ bum pa phyi nang gi mtshams su/

mu tig dkar dmar/ byi ru dkar dmar/ sa le sbram/ sog shel/ hor shel/ mu men/ g.yu spus legs pa/ che chung rnams sil bur blugs te bum pa yongs su gang ba'i steng du/ nor bu zur gsum pa kha rgyan gyi tshul du bzhag pa/ de'i phyi rol du'ang gser/ dngul/ g.yu/ byu ru/ spos shel sogs khrol blugs su btab pa/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin yab yum gyi mtshams bzhir rin po che'i bum pa bzhi yod pa'i nang du/ 'bru sna/ sman sna/ rin po che'i rigs tshang ba/ khyad par g.yu dang*/ gser/ dngul gyi ling ba sogs dri bzang gi chus byugs te bkang ba/ de'i mtshams su gu gu sha'i ting che ba bdun/ sum gser gyi rgya'i ting bdun/ mu tig dmar po'i phor ba thod gzugs su yod pa bre tshad tsam pa cig nya phyis kyi ka li bzhi/ dngul gyi rkos can phyi a ru la rgya srang dang me tog gi rkos yod pa bzhi rnams kyi nang du/ kha che ga bur sogs sna sbyor/ mar dri ma med pas byas pa'i mchod yon/ 'o ma dang ga bur sbyar ba'i zhabs bsil/ nas dkar/ 'bras dkar/ gser/ dngul dang rin po che sna tshogs sbyar ba'i me tog a ka ru/ spos dkar/ sih+la/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po/ gor zho sha sogs la sbyar ba'i bdug spos/ rtsi mar/ 'bru mar/ me shel sogs la sbyar ba'i snang gsal/ kha che/ dzā ti/ ga bur tsan dan sogs sbyar ba'i dri chab/ 'bru sna/ zas sna/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum sogs bcud kyi bye brag dpag tu med pa bsdus pa'i zhal zas rnams brtsegs su rkang gang tsam la dan pa la/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi phras bar mtshams med par brgyan pa/ rgyu bzang po'i me long*/ cang te'u/ sil snyan sogs rol cha'i bye brag dang*/ dri bzang rnams bsdus pa'i dri yi rigs dang*/ rten khebs ma ṇi ma bzang bsgrigs/ se'u ma sogs reg bya'i bye brag kyang dpag tu med pa/ gos dar kha dog rigs mi gcig pa yug bdun/ rin po che'i rigs du ma bdar ba'i phur ma dri bzang gi chus byugs pas seb rtsags te rlung gis kyang mi thar bas bkang ba/

mtshams mtshams su zas sna'i bye brag dang*/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas chos dung dkar po zung 'brel/ hor dang bal yul gyi sil snyan/ rgya nag gi rdo dril rtse dgu rtse lnga zung 'brel gan shubs dang sbrags pa/ rin thang gzhal du med pa/ ma na ho kha dog sna lnga'i pad 'dab kyi dbus na/ pad sdong che ba gnyis la chung ba dgu 'khril zhing skyes pa'i tshul gyi steng du pad 'dab che ba gcig gis khyab pa/ de'i steng du pad 'dab sum rtsegs kyi steng du mchod lha yod pa/ glang po che'i sog pa tshang ma la bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad dang*/ sa rgyan gnam rgyan gyi ri mo tshang ba/ gan dkar phyi dmar po 'brug dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi ri mo yod pa/ shubs smyug se ta hung la sum gser gyi mdzo sna dang chab lce yod pa/ yang rgya nag gi mchod rdzas/ smyug se ta hung kha sgyer nyis brtsegs yod pa'i ngo mtshar can/ rin po che'i rigs su gtogs pa'i 'bud dung dmar khra ze ba dgu yod pa'i mtshan nyid tshang ba gcig be ta'i 'bras bu la sum gser gyi 'khyud rgyan yod pa/ shing thog bil wa sogs 'bras bu'i rigs tshang ba/ ma na ho ljang khu'i phang sder che ba rnams rin po che'i mchod rdzas kyi bye brag gi gang ba rnams yod/ 'khor lo'i sgrig mtshams rin po che dang bzang drug gi lde gus byugs/ ras dkar dri ma med pa'i bsgril/ tshos kha dog sna lnga'i dar gyis bsdams te bzhugs/ de'i phyi'i bar 'khyams la/ 'khor pad phyin gyi nang du/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad la/ stag gzig dom dred kyi pags pa las ma song ba mgo rna tshang ba/ gu gul dang spos kyis bdugs/ dri bzang gi chus bkrus te dar sna lngas brgyan nas bting ba'i thog gi phyogs bzhir/ gsol khrab gzhis kha brag dkar dang mgos mnyam zer ba'i/ phyis rgyun so ba kha ti'i zhol dang bcas pa/ yang khrab bod dmar phyis gsar kha ti'i zhol yod pa gcig dang gnyis kyi gtsos pa'i khrab rmog gi rigs/

ral gri khro chu 'khyil pa/ rgya mtsho khug pa gnyis kyi gtsos pa'i sgrom ral bzhi/ sgang gzar blug gzar rgya nag gi dngul tshag ma/ shing thog gi rigs tshang ma'i dos/ ka ra/ bu ram/ spos dkar/ tshos sogs ltang rtse sna tshang mang ba/ ja sig sman bzang drug gi dos sogs khod snyoms par bsgrigs pa'i mtshams tshor/ tsan dan/ a ka ru/ rgya gser sogs kyi phor pa/ rgya'i dkar gyi sder ma/ sum gser gyi kong bu/ spos phor sogs ya mtshan grangs mang ba'i nang du/ mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshang bas yongs su bkang ba/ zas sna'i rigs/ 'bru'i rigs/ lan tsha'i rigs/ gos dar/ snam phrug zangs spyad lcags cha sogs dngos po'i rigs kyis yongs su bkang*/ bar mtshams thams cad la gser/ dngul/ g.yu/ mu tig mu men/ byu ru/ spos shel sogs phye ma byas pa'i phur mas bsabs/ zas sna dang dngos po'i bye brag thams cad dri bzang gi chus bkrus/ bzang drug gi lde gus byugs/ spos mchog gi bdugs te phul/ phyir chos skyong bang rim gyi lha rigs dang bstun pa'i gzungs sngags tshang ma rgya shog la dngul gyis bris/ zhus dag par byas/ lha gar bzhugs kyi thad ma 'dzol bar nang du bar mtshams med par bkod/ mtha' rnams mi 'gyur ba rin po che'i gzer gyis bsdams/ logs thams cad kyi yig 'bru la ma gnod par dri bzang dang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i sa sna rnams dri ma med pa'i gar spyin gyis sbyar nas yod de/ de'i steng thang shing gtsang ma'i spang leb kyis phibs pa'i steng du sdom dar dkar po bar mtshams med par bkab pa'i dbus su/ bkra shis pa'i kha btags/ chos kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong yod pa/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gser gyis bris pa bting ba'i phyogs mtshams/ rin po che'i gser gyis bsdams pa'i lte ba'i dbus su tsan dan lde ba lde ru la byas pa'i srog shing gru bzhi/ cha snyoms pa nyi zla dang nor bu'i tog phyin la/ shing mthud med par bsnyegs pa/

bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa/ bka' brgyud bang rim rnams rim gyis yod pa'i bang rim re re dang mthun pa'i thad/ rgyud sde so so'i gzungs sngags mthing shog la dngul dkar gyis bris pa/ yang gan shog dkar po la/ mtshal da chus gzungs sngags bris pa/ bar mtshams med par sgril/ dri bzang dang mngar gsum gyis bsdams/ za 'og gi skud pas dkris pa'i thog tu/ rgya shog kha btags shin tu che ba zur ma nyams pa la/ srog shing brtan pa'i gzungs sngags tshang ma/ dngul dkar gyis bris nas sgril ba/ srog shing gi phyogs bzhi khar dar dkar pos bsdams te btsugs/ de nas bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud/ bka' brgyud bang rim rnams kyi nang gi phyogs bzhi/ mtshams dang bcas par lha rang rang gi gzungs sngags/ mthing shog la dngul dkar gyis bris pa/ phyi yi lha dang ma 'dzol bar dri bzang dang mngar gsum gyis lde gus sbyar/ rin po che'i gzer gyis bsdams nas bzhugs/ yang phyi'i rtse zhol thams cad du bzhugs pa'i lha 'phrul ma gang yod dang*/ ka ba ka rgyan sogs srog chags kyi gzugs 'gros dang bcas pa'i nang bzhugs rten 'dus ril bu re/ srog shing rten byed kyi gzungs sngags tshang ba/ rin po che sna tshang gi thum bu dang bcas pa rnams la/ kha dog sna lnga'i tshon skud dang*/ gos dar dri ma med pas sgril/ bzang drug gi lde gus byugs nas bzhugs/ chos skyong bang rim gyi ye shes mgon po'i thugs kar/ rdo rje gdan gyi sgo bzhi'i bdag po mgon po klu sgrub bstan pa'i gnyer mdzad pa'i dus/ lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'i 'gram du skyo sangs la byon pa'i tshe/ rgya mtsho'i tshur mtha' rlabs 'khrug pa'i steng du/ chu'i ze 'bru pad 'dab bzhi'i tshul du yod pa'i steng du/ chos skyong mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ mu men gyi mdog ltar 'od zer 'bar ba/

sku'i chag tshad 'khyud gang pa tsam zhal lho nub la gzigs pa gcig 'dug la/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis chu thog gsum mar grags pa'i bstod pa sho lo ka gsum gsungs pa'i mod/ khyod nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i srung ma gcig yin na/ rdo rje gdan gyi srung ma mdzod la gtor ma gsol ba la byon/ phyi pa'i lha gcig yin na rgya mtsho'i mthar dengs gsungs pas/ rdo ba sran ma'i mdog ltar nag la 'gril ba/ che chung ltar kha'i tshad tsam zhig blo bur du chu'i pad 'dab steng du don te/ nga ni dur khrod brgyad kyi bdag /bsil ba'i tshal gyi gtso bo ste// rdo rje gdan dang na len+d+ra// ka ma shī la la sogs pa// sangs rgyas bstan pa nga yis bsrung*// nga yi snying po 'di ga yin// nga 'dod rdo 'di spyan drongs la// zhi rgyas dbang drag sgrub la sogs// gsol ba gang btab dngos grub 'byung*// gsung ba'i lung bstan nas sku de nyid kyang thim/ chu'i steng du bshar thog tu sran ma 'gril ba ltar rdo ba de rang bzhin gyi byon te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi sku chos kyi steng du gdan drangs/ chos skyong gi gtso bo mdzad/ rjes su sangs rgyas grags pa brgyud dpal chen rga los bse'i sgam bur bcug ste bod du gdan drangs/ chos skyong sgam bu mar grags pa/ ye shes mgon po dngos su bzhugs pa'i bla rdo la/ za 'og gi na bza' sum brtsegs/ dri bzang gi lde gus byugs te bzhugs/ de la sogs pa'i chos skyong bang rim/ nor lha/ bstan srung*/ rgyal chen bzhi/ rgyud sde bzhi/ bka' brgyud bang rim phyin gyi lugs sku rnams la'ang rten 'dus ril bu re/ so so rang rang gi gzungs sngags tshang ma/ rin po che pad+ma rā ga/ bai ḍūr+ya/ pud pa/ rag kha/ gser/ dngul/ g.yu/ mu tig byu ru/ spos shel/ mchong*/ dung*/ shel dkar/ mu men sogs sna tshang ba/ tsan+dan/ ga pur/ dzā ti sogs bzang drug sman gyi bye brag dang*/ 'bras dang nas dkar sogs 'bru'i rigs dang*/

ka ra bu ram sogs rtsi bcud du ma dang*/ rgun 'brum star kha sogs shing thog dang*/ 'bras bu'i rigs tshang ma/ gos zi hung la jus ling sogs rgya hor gyi gos dar tshos rigs du ma dang bcas te/ bar mtshams rnams rin po che bdar ba'i phur ma/ dri bzang gi lde gus byugs te/ go rim bzhin lha re re'i nang bzhugs su bzhugs so// yang pad chen gyi thog yan/ bla med bang rim man gyi nang gsung rab kyi bzhugs tshul/ mnyam med chos kyi rje dbang rin po che'i thugs dam bstan 'gyur/ rje de nyid kyi phyag nas grangs mang ba bzhugs pa'i cha lag tshang ba/ snga dus kyi bka' 'gyur phyi rabs pas bcos lhad ma song ba byin rlabs shin tu che ba/ 'dzam gling chos kyi rje nyer gnyis rin po che khu dbon gyi phyag nas bzhugs pa/ yang po ti thor bu pa la/ phal chen/ dkon rtsegs/ bka' sna tshogs gzhung khrid tshang ma/ po ti thams cad la gos chen dang dar bzang po'i na bzas sgril te/ spos kyi bye brag gi bdugs/ dri bzang gis byugs/ glegs shing*/ sku rags dang bcas pa chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa bzhin skor tshul go rim ma log par bzhugs pa'i bar mtshams/ rin po che sna tshang*/ bzang drug spos kyi bye brag sogs kyi thum bus bkang ba rnams bzhugs/ de'i steng du bka' brgyud bang rim gyi nang skor/ shing las grub pa'i re mig sgrom bu'i tshul du yod pa/ bzo spras thon shing gab 'grig pa'i nang*/ gos dar bzang po/ za 'og sogs kyi bzhugs gdan sna tshang*/ sku snyes dang bcas pa bsgrigs pa'i shar gyi re mig dang por/ lho gnas mchog dpal gyi tsā ri/ pho brang g.yu mtsho'i nang du grub thob gong ma rnams kyi zhal gzigs/ mkhas grub tsan+d+ra pra bha bas ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang nas gdan drangs pa'i rdo yi chos 'byung gi steng du/ phag mo lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs/ 'bur du byon pa 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba 'gran zla dang bral ba'i sku rnams la/

gser gyis lde gus byugs/ gos dar za 'og sogs dri ma med pa'i na bza' sum brtsegs/ yang spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal gso'i sku li dkar/ khri rgyab tsan dan/ yang spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i sku li dkar gcig rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku li dmar gnyis/ rje nā ro pa'i khrus bum/ rgyu rin po che dzhai k+ṣim las grub pa bzo spras shin tu legs shing*/ rje nā ro pa dang mnga' bdag mar pa yab sras kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun ma nyams par yod pa/ mgul dkris na bza' dar dpyangs dang bcas pa gcig dzam bha la'i sku li dkar las grub pa gcig rnams la/ na bza' gos dar dri ma med pa sum brtsegs sgron/ dri bzang lde gus byugs/ bar mtshams med pa rin po che'i thum bus bkang*/ za 'og gi bzhugs gdan bla bre dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i mdun/ sum gser las grub pa'i rgya'i ting*/ li'i ting 'gag ma gsum tshar/ rgya gser ljang khra'i phor pa/ rin po che sna lnga'i phra bkod pa gcig dung chos dngul shog dang bcas pa'i nang du mchod pa'i bye brag kha che gur gum ga pur sogs mar dri ma med par sbyar ba'i mchod yon/ sbrang rtsi 'o ma ga pur rnams sbyar ba'i zhabs bsil/ nas kyi rigs tshang ba/ 'bras/ gser/ dngul/ mu men/ mu tig dkar dmar/ byu ru/ hor shel/ sog spos/ g.yu/ pad+ma rā ga margad/ in+d+ra nī la sogs rin po che sna tshang las grub pa'i me tog a ka ru nag po/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po/ go shir+ṣa rgya hor gyi spos/ sih+la/ spos kyi rigs byed sna tshang la sbyar ba'i bdug spos/ rtsi bcud kyi snying po mar dkar ser/ 'bru mar/ me shel sogs kyis brgyan pa'i snang gsal/ ga bur/ dzā ti sogs sbyar ba'i dri chab/ shel ka ra/ rgya ka ra/ bye ma ka ra/ bu ram dkar smug rtsam dkar/ sha skam/ thud dkar ser/ zhun thud sogs la sbyar ba'i zhal zas/ 'dod yon lnga/ me long*/ pi wang sogs rol mo/

rten khebs sogs gos dar bzang po sna tshang ba'i reg bya sogs mchod pa'i bye brag rnams mchod gshom re re la'ang sna tshang ba yod/ shar gyi re mig dbus ma'i nang du/ rtogs ldan shrī ri phug pas bzhengs pa'i skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi sku la/ mnyam med sgam po pa'i ring bsrel/ rje phag mo gru pa'i shangs mtshal/ 'phel gdung bzhugs pa/ rje 'jig rten mgon po rang gi phyag nas brgya rtsa bzhugs pa/ mar me dang me tog rgyun du 'dzin pa mos gus can la gsung lan gsum du byon pa/ gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sku gcig rin po che dzhai k+ṣim gyi mchod rten rkang gang pa/ de'i bum pa'i nang du tsan dan dkar po'i za ma tog gi nang du/ za hor rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi 'khor mnga' 'bangs dang bcas pa lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du 'byon nus par byed pa'i skye bdun gyi sku sha slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bod du bsnams/ gter du sbas pa/ mnga' bdag nyang gis gter nas phyung ba'i na bza' dang bcas pa/ rje til+li pa'i phyag mdzub gser gyi lde gus byugs pa na bza' dang bcas pa gcig mchod rten gyi ldeb la bal gyi maṇ+ḍal la/ bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi ri mo rdzong ris su grub pa gcig ba so'i za ma tog thel gyi bre tshad las mi chung ba rim pa gsum du yod pa'i nang du/ gser phye brdar ba'i nang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon dzaṃ bha la sku gar lugs su bzhugs pa/ bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi phyag nas bzhugs pa/ mar me dang me tog rgyun du 'dzin pa/ mchod pa'i bye brag bshams 'phral/ 'dod yon gsol ba gang btab kyi dngos grub rtsol med du 'byung ba'i sku la za 'og zi khyim gyi na bza' sgron/ dri bzang gi lde gus byugs te gser gyi phur ma'i nang du mgul phyin nub pa/ yang rdo shel las grub pa'i dzaṃ nag byin rlabs shin tu che ba'i sku la za 'og zi khyim gyi na bza' gsol/

dri bzang gis byugs/ rin po che sna tshogs dang bzang drug gi thum bus bkang ste bzhugs/ yang za 'og zi khyim gyi na bza'i nang du/ ma cig lab sgron/ yum bdag med ma/ ye shes mkha' 'gro bsod nams dpal 'dren gsum gyi dbu skra/ dri bzang gi lde gus byugs te/ rin po che sna tshogs dang bzang drug gi bkang ba bzhugs cing*/ gser gyi phur ma'i steng*/ kha che ga pur/ 'bras bu gsum gyis yongs su gang ba bzhugs/ yang ba so'i za ma tog gi nang du/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i dbu skra/ gdung rus/ gdung sol/ bram ze skye bdun gyi sku sha 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi rten/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi na bza'/ dbu lo/ phyag sen sogs bsdus pa'i rten 'dus ril bus bkang ba gcig mnyam med sgam po pa'i phyag ting dang bcas pa la/ za 'og sogs na bza' sum brtsegs la dri bzang gis byugs te/ mtshams tshor rin po che sna lnga'i thum bus bkang ba/ bzhugs gdan sum brtsegs/ sku snyes/ za 'og gi bla bre dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ mchod rdzas la gu gu sha'i phor pa/ sum gser gyi gong bu/ yang sum gser gyi spos 'dzugs/ li'i ting 'gag ma rnams su mchod pa'i bye brag kha che ga bur sogs mar dri ma med pa sbyar ba'i mchod yon/ sbrang rtsi 'o ma ga pur rnams sbyar ba'i zhabs bsil/ nas kyi rigs tshang ma/ 'bras/ gser/ dngul/ mu men/ mu tig dkar dmar/ byu ru/ hor shel/ sog spos/ g.yu/ pad+ma rā ga margad/ in+d+ra nī la sogs rin po che sna tshang las grub pa'i me tog a ka ru nag po/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po/ go zho sha rgya hor gyi spos/ sih+la/ spos kyi rigs byed sna tshang la sbyar ba'i bdug spos/ rtsi bcud kyi snying po mar dkar ser/ 'bru mar/ me shel sogs kyis brgyan pa'i snang gsal/ ga pur/ dzā ti sogs sbyar ba'i dri chab/ shel ka ra/ rgyal mo ka ra/ bye ma ka ra/ bu ram dkar smug

rtsam dkar/ sha skam/ thud dkar ser/ zhun thud sogs la sbyar ba'i zhal zas/ 'dod yon lnga/ me long*/ pi wang*/ rol mo rten khebs sogs gos dar bzang po sna tshang ba'i reg bya sogs mchod pa'i bye brag rnams mchod gshom re re la'ang sna tshang ba yod/ rol mo'i bye brag dril bu rtse lnga phyag mtshan dang bcas pa gcig re mig gsum pa la/ tsan dan gyi za ma tog gi nang du/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i sku/ byang chub ljon shing las grub pa gcig 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi sku li dmar las grub pa gcig yang ba so'i za ma tog gi nang du/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa'i na bza'/ dbu skra/ thams cad mkhyen pa karma pa bdun brgyud kyi gdung rus/ na bza'/ yang jo bo rje'i gdung rus/ grub thob gling chen ras pa'i gdung rus/ mkhas grub u rgyan pa'i na bza'/ yang rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i na bza'/ mar pa dbu yag gi sku sha grub chen mi tra dzo ki'i sgom thag dum bu/ paṇa chen shākya shrī'i dbu skra/ gu ru chos dbang gi sku sha/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi shu kra/ rje btsun mi la'i na bza'/ yang bde gshegs phag mo gru pa'i zhal chas/ ma hā bho dhi'i shing*/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal gyi shing dang bcas pa rnams bzhugs/ yang til+li'i sprul pa rgyal ba gcung rin po che'i sku gser zangs las grub pa/ rgya mtho gsum pa/ rag zangs kyi khri rgyab dang bcas pa/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dang gcung khu dbon gyi ring bsrel nya phyis kyi za ma tog gang thugs khar bzhugs pa rnams la na bza' sum brtsegs/ sku snyes/ za 'og gi bla bre/ bzhugs gdan sum brtsegs dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ gu gu sha'i ting dang*/ li'i ting rnams su mchod pa'i bye brag kha che ga bur sogs mar dri ma med pa sbyar ba'i mchod yon/ sbrang rtsi/ 'o ma/ ga pur rnams sbyar ba'i zhabs bsil/ nas kyi rigs tshang ma/

'bras/ gser/ dngul/ mu men/ mu tig dkar dmar/ byu ru/ hor shel/ sog spos/ g.yu/ pad+ma rā ga margad/ in+d+ra nī la sogs rin po che sna tshang las grub pa'i me tog a ka ru nag po/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po/ go shir+ṣa/ rgya hor gyi spos/ sih+la/ spos kyi rigs byed sna tshang la sbyar ba'i bdug spos/ rtsi bcud kyi snying po mar dkar ser/ 'bru mar/ me shel sogs kyi brgyan pa'i snang gsal/ ga bur/ dzā ti sogs sbyar ba'i dri chab/ shel ka ra/ rgyal mo ka ra/ bye ma ka ra/ bu ram dkar smug rtsam dkar/ sha skam/ thud dkar ser/ zhun thud sogs la sbyar ba'i zhal zas/ 'dod yon lnga/ me long*/ pi wang sogs rol mo/ rten khebs sogs gos dar bzang po sna tshang ba'i reg bya sogs mchod pa'i bye brag rnams mchod gshom re re la'ang sna tshang ba yod/ rol mo'i bye brag la hor chal cha gcig rnams yod/ yang lho'i re mig dang por/ byang chub ljon shing las grub pa'i ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku/ rgya mtho gang ba/ zangs rag gi khri rgyab dang bcas pa/ sum gser las grub pa'i za ma tog gi nang du/ mnyam med dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po'i dbu skra/ tshems/ de'i yum rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo'i sprul pa yum chos rgyal bzang mo'i tshems/ thugs dam phreng ba be ta las grub pa gcig chos kyi rje nyer gnyis rin po che'i thugs dam phreng ba rgya gar gyi shing blag sha gdong drug las grub pa gcig skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi thugs dam sgo mang gi rten/ rje nyid kyi phyag nas brgya rtsa bzhugs pa/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sku rtse khru gang pa gser zangs las grub pa gcig rnams la/ bzhugs gdan sum brtsegs/ na bza' sum brtsegs/ bar mtshams rin po che'i thum bus bkang ba/ sku snyes/ za 'og gi bla bre dang bcas te bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ mchod rdzas gu gu sha'i ting*/ li'i ting 'gag ma/ gser gyi ting rnams su mchod pa'i bye brag

kha che/ ga pur sogs mar dri ma med pa sbyar ba'i mchod yon/ sbrang rtsi/ 'o ma/ ga bur rnams sbyar ba'i zhabs bsil/ nas kyi rigs tshang ma/ 'bras/ gser/ dngul/ mu men/ mu tig dkar dmar/ byu ru/ hor shel/ sog spos/ g.yu/ pad+ma rā ga margad/ in+d+ra nī la sogs rin po che sna tshang las grub pa'i me tog a ka ru nag po/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po/ go shir+ṣa/ rgya hor gyi spos/ sih+la/ spos kyi rigs byed sna tshang la sbyar ba'i bdug spos/ rtsi bcud kyi snying po mar dkar ser/ 'bru mar/ me shel sogs kyi brgyan pa'i snang gsal/ ga pur/ dzā ti sogs sbyar ba'i dri chab/ shel ka ra/ rgyal mo ka ra/ bye ma ka ra bu ram dkar smug rtsam dkar/ sha skam/ thud dkar ser/ zhun thud sogs la sbyar ba'i zhal zas/ 'dod yon lnga/ me long*/ pi wang sogs rol mo/ rten khebs sogs gos dar bzang po sna tshang ba'i reg bya sogs/ mchod pa'-i bye brag rnams mchod gshom re re la'ang sna tshang ba/ rol mo'i bye brag rgya dril rtse lnga phyag mtshan dang bcas pa gcig rnams yod/ re'u mig gnyis pa'i nang du/ til+li'i sprul pa rgyal ba gcung gi sku gser zangs las grub pa rtse khru gang ba sgom zhwa khri rgyab dang bcas pa gcig skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i gser sku/ rje nyid kyis 'phel gdung bzhugs pa/ sgom zhwa/ rag zangs kyi khri rgyab dang bcas pa gcig lho gnas mchog dpal gyi tsā ri'i yul gyi smad/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal gyi shing ljon pa la/ rang byon gyi sāts+tsha grangs mang ba 'bur du byon pa khru gang pa cig rnams la/ gser gyi lde gu/ dri bzang gis byugs pa/ gos dar dri ma med pa'i na bza' sum brtsegs bar mtshams rin po che'i thum bus bkang ba/ bzhugs gdan sum brtsegs/ sku snyes/ za 'og gi bla bre dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ mchod rdzas la/ gu gu sha'i ting*/ sum gser gyi ting*/ li'i ting*/

dung chos rkos ma gsum rnams la mchod pa'i bye brag kha che ga pur sogs/ mar dri ma med pa sbyar ba'i mchod yon/ sbrang rtsi/ 'o ma/ ga pur rnams sbyar ba'i zhabs bsil/ nas kyi bye brag tshang ma/ 'bras/ gser/ dngul/ mu men/ mu tig dkar dmar/ byu ru/ hor shel/ sog spos/ g.yu/ pad+ma rā ga margad/ in+d+ra nī la sogs rin po che sna tshang la grub pa'i me tog a ka ru nag po/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po/ go shir+ṣa/ rgya hor gyi spos/ sih+la/ spos kyi rigs byed sna tshogs la sbyar ba'i bdug spos/ rtsi bcud kyi snying po mar dkar ser/ 'bru mar/ me shel sogs kyis brgyan pa'i snang gsal/ ga bur/ dzā ti sogs sbyar ba'i dri chab/ shel ka ra/ rgyal mo ka ra/ bye ma ka ra/ bu ram dkar smug rtsam dkar/ sha skam/ thud dkar ser/ zhun thud sogs la sbyar ba'i zhal zas/ 'dod yon lnga/ me long*/ pi wang sogs rol mo/ rten khebs sogs gos dar bzang po sna tshang ba'i reg bya sogs/ mchod pa'-i bye brag rnams mchod gshom re re la'ang sna tshang yod/ nub kyi re'u mig dang po'i nang du/ rje phag mo gru pa'i gser sku dran pa gsal byed la sgom zhwa rag zangs kyi khri rgyab dang bcas pa gcig skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi gser sku/ rje nyid kyi ring bsrel lnga dung g.yas 'khyil gnyis dang bdun thugs khar bzhugs pa byin rlabs shin tu che ba'i sgom zhwa/ zangs gser las grub pa'i khri rgyab dang bcas pa gcig yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog gi gser sku/ thugs khar mnga' bdag mar pa'i tshems bzhugs pa/ mar pa bu chen bzhi dang bcas pas phyag nas bdun phrag 'thor ba'i byin rlabs shin tu che ba gcig rnams la/ gos dar dri ma med pa'i na bza' sum brtsegs/ bar mtshams rin po che'i thum bus bkang ba/ dri bzang gi lde gus byugs pa/ bzhugs gdan sum brtsegs/ sku snyes/ za 'og gi bla bre dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i mdun/ mchod rdzas/

gu gu sha'i ting*/ li'i ting*/ sum gser gyi ting rnams su mchod pa'i bye brag kha che la sogs pa nas gos dar bzang po sna tshang la sogs pa'i reg bya sogs tshang ma gong ltar yod/ rol mo'i bye brag hol chal cha gcig re'u mig gnyis pa la skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi gser sku byin rlabs can gcig snga dus kyi rten skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi thugs dam sgo mang gi lugs phung jo mo khams gsum ma'i sku rtse khru gang pa/ 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum kha'i rten bzhugs pa gcig gser zangs las grub pa rje nyid kyi phyag nas brgya rtsa bzhugs pa spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal bso'i sku li dmar las grub pa gcig rnams la/ gos dar dri ma med pa'i na bza' sum brtsegs/ bar mtshams rin po che'i thum bus bkang ba/ bzhugs gdan sum brtsegs/ sku snyes/ za 'og gi bla bre dang bcas pa/ dri bzang gi lde gus byugs te bzhugs pa'i mdun du mchod rdzas/ gu gu sha'i ting*/ sum gser gyi ting*/ li'i ting*/ bal ting rnams kyi nang du mchod pa'i bye brag kha che la sogs pa nas gong ltar/ gos dar bzang po sna tshang la sogs pa'i reg bya sogs tshang ba dang*/ rol mo'i bye brag re'u mig gsum pa'i nang du/ byams pa'i sku li dmar rgyar mtho gang pa/ jo bo rjes rgya gar nas gdan drangs pa'i byin rlabs can gcig mnyam med u rgyan pad+ma rgyal po'i gser sku/ gter ston kun skyong gling pas gter nas gdan drangs pa'i 'dzam gling sum gnyis kyi dpal bskyed nus pa gcig zhwa nag cod pan 'dzin pa karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i gser sku gcig zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po'i gser sku gcig rnams la gos dar dri ma med pa'i na bza' sum brtsegs/ bar mtshams rin po che'i thum bus bkang ba/ bzhugs gdan sum brtsegs/ sku snyes/ za 'og gi bla bre/ dri bzang gi lde gus byugs te bzhugs pa'i mdun du/

sum gser gyi pad sder/ li'i ting*/ bal ting rnams su mchod pa'i bye brag kha che sogs pa nas/ gos dar bzang po la sogs gong ltar tshang ba/ rol mo'i bye brag byang gi re'u mig dang po'i nang du/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis ma'i sku li dmar las grub pa/ jo bo rjes rgya gar nas spyan drangs khu ston la thub pa zangs chos can dang mnyam du gnang ba'i rten skal ya mtshan mchog tu che ba gcig mchod rten rtsa to rgya gar ma gcig yang li dmar las grub pa'i mchod lha mdzes ma'i sku gcig rnams la/ gos dar dri ma med pa'i na bza' sum brtsegs/ bar mtshams rin po che'i thum bus bkang ba/ bzhugs gdan sum brtsegs/ sku snyes/ za 'og gi bla bre dri bzang gi lde gus byugs te bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ mchod rdzas/ gu gu sha'i ting*/ li'i ting*/ sum gser gyi kong bu/ dkar sder rnams su mchod pa'i bye brag kha che la sogs pa nas gong ltar/ gos dar bzang po la sogs gong ltar tshang ba rol mo'i bye brag yang re mig gsum pa'i nang du/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sku li dmar las grub pa/ byin rlabs shin tu che ba gcig rdo rje sems dpa'i sku li dmar gcig spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal bso'i sku li dmar gcig rnams la/ gos dar dri ma med pa'i na bza' sum brtsegs/ bar mtshams rin po che'i thum bus bkang ba/ bzhugs gdan sum brtsegs/ sku snyes/ za 'og gi bla bre dri bzang gi lde gus byugs te bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ mchod rdzas/ gu gu sha'i ting*/ sum gser gyi ting*/ li'i ting*/ dkar sder rnams su mchod pa'i bye brag kha che la sogs pa nas gos dar bzang po la sogs gong ltar tshang ba dang*/ rol mo'i bye brag hor dril phyag mtshan dang bcas pa gcig rnams bzhugs pa'i re mig bcu pa'i steng du/ za 'og gi bla bres bar mtshams med par phub pa'i steng du shin tu bzang ba'i spang leb khod snyoms shing ngos 'jam pa bsgrigs pa'i dbus su/

bre chen gyi nang gi mthil dang logs la/ dri bzang gi lde gus byugs pa'i mthil du/ bkra shis pa'i kha btags la/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bting ba'i phyogs mtshams rin po che'i gzer gyis bsdams pa'i steng bre nang du/ spyan snga rdo rje rin chen pa'i thugs dam/ gan shog la 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyis bris pa'i mdo 'dzam gling rgyan sku tshad shin tu che ba/ na bza' sku rags dang bcas pa gnyis kyang rje 'di nyid kyis nang bzhugs rang la dmigs nas/ gan shog la rin po ches 'bur du bzhengs pa'i sngags 'bum chen mo/ na bza' za 'og dang bzang sgrigs sogs sum brtsegs sgron pa/ glegs shing sku rags dang bcas pa gcig rnams bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ mchod rdzas kyi bye brag rje 'di nyid kyis rgyun ldan gyi gsol spyad/ gan dkar 'brug ma chag med sum gser gyi stegs dang bcas pa/ smyug bse'i gsol zhal gser gshog ma/ gu gu sha'i gsol sder shin tu che ba/ dngul gyi pad sder/ ma na ho'i phud sder/ smug thags kyi dkar gzugs ta hun gser kha ma ya mtshan shin tu che ba/ nya phyis kyi gsol zhal bre tshad las mi chung ba gnyis/ mu tig dmar po'i thod gzugs stegs dang bcas pa/ de rnams kyi nang du mchod pa'i bye brag la/ kha che ga pur sogs mar dri ma med par sbyar ba'i mchod yon/ sbrang rtsi ga bur rnams sbyar ba'i zhabs bsil/ nas kyi rigs tshang ma/ 'bras/ gser/ dngul/ mu men/ mu tig dkar dmar/ byu ru/ hor shel/ sog spos/ g.yu/ pad+ma rā ga margad/ in+d+ra nī la sogs rin po che sna tshang la grub pa'i me tog a ka ru nag po/ tsan dan sbrul snying*/ go shir+ṣa/ rgya hor gyi spos/ sih+la sogs spos kyi rigs byed sna tshogs kyi bdug spos/ rtsi bcud kyi snying po mar dkar ser/ 'bru mar/ me shel sogs kyis brgyan pa'i snang gsal/ ga bur dzā ti sogs sbyar ba'i dri chab/

shel ka ra/ rgya ka ra/ bye ma ka ra/ bu ram dkar smug rtsam dkar/ sha skam/ thud dkar ser/ zhun thud sogs 'o mar sbyar ba'i zhal zas/ me long pi wang gling bu sogs rol mo/ rten khebs sogs gos dar bzang po sna tshang ba'i reg bya sogs/ mchod pa'i bye brag rnams tshang ba bkod pa/ sum gser gyi maṇ+ḍal la g.yu'i tshom bu bkod pa dang bcas pa'i steng du/ za 'og gi bla bre phub pa/ de'i steng du spang leb bsgrigs pa'i steng gsung rab phyag dpe bzhugs pa la/ rgya dpe za ma tog dum bu bdun pa cha lag tshang ba/ dum bu re la gan shog srin bal gyi steng du gos ljang khu gser ma brtsegs pa'i sbyar spang*/ khod snyoms par bsdams pa/ phyi la gser gyi ri mo bye brag dpag med bris pa/ 'jam byus khra bo'i sku rags na bza' dkris byas pa sne la ba so'i cha ru/ zheng la sor do/ dkyus sor lnga yod pa/ pad 'dab kyi ri mo 'bur du yod pa/ de'i phyi gying khras tshos gnyis kyi rten khebs dar gnam kha'i rgyab dar yod pa/ gos g.yu kha'i sdom dar na bza' dkris kyi sna rdzangs/ ba so'i cha ru gong dang mthun pa'i po ti gcig ka lā pa'i mdo le'u bzhi pa/ gan shog la gser gyi 'bur du bzhengs pa'i glegs shing la 'dzam bu'i chu gser gyi lde gus byugs pa/ na bza' gan dar sngon po/ de'i phyi rgya ras dkar po dri ma med pa'i na bza' gnyis brtsegs yod pa/ yang sman lha'i mdo rgya nag tu bzhengs pa dbu lha dang rgya yig sogs yod pa gcig la/ na bza' dar ljang khu byas pa gcig rgyud skor la bde mchog gi rgyud gnyis gan shog la ser 'jam du bris pa'i lto dkar gyi dbu lha la bde mchog dang rdor sems kyi sku 'bur du yod pa/ yang dgyes pa rdo rje rtsa rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa gan shog la bris pa'i lto dkar gyi dbu lha dgyes rdor dang rdor sems 'bur dod yod pa/ yang dus 'khor bsdus rgyud dbu lha sogs gong dang mthun pa/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud dbu lha dang bcas pa gong dang mthun pa/ chos tshan re la zhal khebs gos dar bzang po'i gnyis brtsegs re/ na bza' gan dar dmar pos byas pa yod/ dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'grel dri ma med pa'i 'od/ na bza' dar dmar po/ de'i phyi la rten khebs dang gnyis brtsegs/ glegs shing glegs thag dang bcas pa'i po ti che ba gcig yang thugs dam phyag dpe'i khrod nas pod kham che ba gcig gi nang du/ thog mar bka' brgyud gsang mtshan/ gar gyi nyams dgu/ lha'i bkra shis/ rje gsum ldan ma/ skyob pas gsungs pa'i mgur chen brgyad/ rje nyid rang gis mdzad pa'i bka' brgyud spyi bstod/ phyag chen gsol 'debs/ rje dbang la bstod pa'i sku bzhi ma/ rje 'di nyid la mang thos dkon mchog rat+nas bstod pa 'gro bla/ ma ṇi bkra shis ma/ rnam thar dri med ma/ bstan pa ngo mtshar ma/ jo bo'i gsol 'debs/ nyer brgyad pas mdzad pa/ yi ge drug ma'i bstod pa mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ lho rin po che'i gsung mgur/ rje sgam po pa'i spong drug rje btsun gyi gsung mgur/ phun tshogs bco brgyad ma/ bka' brgyud spyi'i bkra shis/ skyob pas mdzad pa'i rgyud sde bzhi'i tshul bstan pa/ gser khang ma/ rje dwags po la bstod pa shes bya ma/ phag gru'i bstod pa dus gsum bdag nyid ma/ skyob pa la gling ras kyis bstod pa nyi shu pa/ rnam thar phyogs bcu ma/ rnam thar za ma tog rnam thar mthong ba don yod dang gsum spyan snga 'bri gung gling pas mdzad pa rnams dang*/ bde mchog bstod pa dpa' bo dbang phyug phyogs skyong bcu'i bstod pa/ bde mchog gi shis brjod/ rdo rje phag mo'i bstod pa/ rnal 'byor pa gnyis su med pas rdo rje phag mo la bstod pa/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i bstod pa/ phag mo'i shis brjod/ grub chen brgyad kyi bstod pa/ grub chen brgyad kyi shis brjod/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ thub pa'i bstod pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis/

rnam 'joms/ tshe dpag med/ gtsug gtor/ 'da' ka ye shes/ sher snying*/ bgres zhus/ bskal bzang rgyan phreng*/ thugs rje chen po'i bstod pa yid 'phrog sdig 'joms tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ seng lding nags kyi sgrol ma'i bstod pa slob dpon ma ti tsi ṭas mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi bstod pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa brgyad las sgrol ba'i bstod pa/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba ma ti tsi ṭas mdzad pa/ sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bstod pa sūr+ya gup+tas mdzad pa/ sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags ma dpal chen mo'i bstod pa/ yang sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa thugs rje chen pos mdzad pa/ yang dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug gis gsungs pa'i sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ dī paṃ ka ra dang lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyis bsgyur ba/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur ba/ me tog phreng ba 'dzin pa slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma la smre sngags kyi bstod pa thams cad mkhyen pa kha che bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma la bstod pa slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa tsan+d+ra go mi chus khyer ba'i dus sgrol ma la bstod pa/ sgrol ma la ka ma la shī las bstod pa/ sgrol ma la bstod pa dpal mar me mdzad bzang pos mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i bstod pa btsun pa zla ba'i zhal gyis mdzad pa/ yang lha mo sgrol ma'i bstod pa tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa lo tsā ba gzhon nu 'bum gyis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma mched bdun la bstod pa skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa dge bshes rwa sgreng pas mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal smon lam dge slong nyi ma bzang pos bsgyur ba/

yang 'jam dpal smon lam klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ spyod 'jug smon lam zhi ba lhas mdzad pa/ byang chub 'byung ba'i smon lam klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ btsun pa zla ba'i smon lam/ rigs kyi smon lam mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ dam pa'i chos spyod la 'jug pa'i yan lag bdun pa btsun pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi bstod pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bstod pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi gzungs bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa mar me mdzad ye shes dang rgya brtson seng gis bsgyur ba/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi bstod pa/ sgrol ma'i mtshan brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa/ yang sgrol ma'i bstod pa gcig me tog phreng ba zhes pa'i bstod pa tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bstod pa/ dam tshig sgrol ma'i bstod pa dpal mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa/ lha mo sgrol ma la dpal phag mo gru pas bstod pa/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa/ chos rjes su dran pa/ dge 'dun rjes su dran pa/ byams pa'i smon lam/ bzang spyod smon lam/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rnams bzhugs pa la/ na bza' lha dar spar ma glegs shing glegs thag dang bcas pa yod pa/ do ha skor po ti gcig gi glegs shing a ka ru las byas pa glegs thag na bza' gan dar ljang khu yod pa gcig bka' brgyud gser phreng na bza' glegs shing glegs thag cha lag tshang ba/ rje btsun mi la'i bka' 'bum yongs su rdzogs pa la/ gan dar ljang khu'i na bza' glegs shing glegs thag dang bcas pa bre'i steng pad+ma'i nang du dwags po rin po che'i bka' 'bum thar pa rin po che'i rgyan glegs shing glegs thag na bza' dang bcas pa cha lag tshang ba/ rje phag gru'i bka' 'bum mthing shog la rin po ches 'bur du bkod pa po ti gnyis la yongs su rdzogs pa/

na bza' dar dkar glegs shing glegs thag dar ser dang bcas pa/ skyob pas mdzad pa'i tsin ta ma ṇi/ de'i steng bum pa'i nang du/ skyob pa rin po che'i bka' 'bum po ti lnga la cha lag yongs su tshang ba glegs shing dang bcas pa la dar ljang khu'i na bza'/ jus smug khra'i sku rags yod pa/ theg chen bstan pa'i snying po'i po ti na bza' dkar po/ glegs shing glegs thag jus khra bo phyi thum dkar sngon gnyis dang bcas pa/ dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa po ti gcig la yongs su rdzogs pa na bza' gan dar ljang khu glegs shing glegs thag dang bcas pa/ phyi thum dkar po yod pa/ yang skyob pa rin po che'i zab chos skor/ zhwa chos/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa/ zhal gdams kyi dkar chag spyan snga 'bri gung gling pas bsgrigs pa'i ri chos/ brgyud rim/ chos byung tshul/ zab chos/ tshe sgrub/ bsrung bzlog dang bcas pa/ mos gus gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang khrid zhal gdams dang bcas pa/ phyi sdaum gsum gnad gcig nang sdom gsum gnad gcig yang gsang sdom gsum gnad gcig de kho na nyid sdom gsum gnad gcig zhus lan chos kyi sgo brgya pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo legs par bskor ba rnam pa gsum gyi bsdus don/ theg pa chen po 'ong ge ma/ thub pa bsod snyoms pa'i 'grel chung dang bcas pa/ bsre ba skor gsum gyi don khrid/ 'bri gung pa'i bka' srol bsre ba'i khrid yig don bsdu/ kun gzhi tshogs 'khor ma/ rten 'brel ri chos/ zab chos thor bu ba/ gtum mo gsum khrid/ lam tshogs pa gsum ldan/ phyag chen a gcig pad dkar gyi man ngag 'dod chags dbang dang bsre ba/ zhe sdang 'pho ba dang bsre ba/ bsre ba'i zhal gdams nor bu'i phreng ba/ ri chos gser khug ma/ ri chos bdud rtsi bum pa/ bcu chos/ sum chos/ sum chos 'khor lo ma/ zhi byed rmang lam ma/ 'khor lo lnga'i gdams pa/ sngags btsan thabs su ngo sprod pa/ yan lag gi rlung lnga'i khrid/ dpal chen zhus lan/

nyams bzhi bcos thabs/ dus drug gtum mo/ gtum mo phyi nang gsang gsum/ gtum mo na tsha bogs 'don/ pha rgyud yang snying*/ ma rgyud yang snying*/ 'pho ba 'ja' tshon ma/ bsre ba chos thun ma/ drod btsan thabs su dbab pa/ snang ba rang sems bka' rgya ma/ grib sel snel gtsang ma/ nad gdon gyi zhal gdams/ bde gshegs kyis mdzad pa yan lag bdun pa ri chos/ gsol 'debs yid bzhin nor bu/ man ngag gi bstan chos dri med/ dbon rin po che'i brjed tho/ dbon gyi tshogs chos/ gtam rgyud/ 'khor lo lnga'i khrid rnams bzhugs pa'i po ti gcig la glegs shing glegs thag na bza' dang bcas pa bzhugs/ yang skyob pa'i rnam thar rdo rje rin po che 'bar ba/ phyag chen lnga ldan gyi gzhung khrid/ rje 'di nyid rang gis mdzad pa'i lnga ldan nor bu'i phreng ba'i gsal byed/ yang rje 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i chos drug rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi rim tshigs bcad ma/ rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i gsung sgros dang chos spyod rab gsal/ 'khor lo bde mchog lu hi pa'i dkyil chog yang rje 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i jo mo lhan cig skyes ma zhal gnyis ma'i mngon dkyil/ yang rje 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid yig yang rje 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mos gus gsang ba 'dus pa dbang khrid zhal gdams kyis brgyan pa/ yang rje nyid kyis mdzad pa 'khor lo sdom pa dang nag po chen po sgrub pa'i las rim gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/ skyob pa rin po ches mdzad pa nag po chen po'i lo rgyus/ yang rje 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa a phyi'i sgrub thabs nor bu bsam 'phel rnams po ti gcig la dar ser po'i na bza' yod pa/ yang rje 'di nyid kyis thugs rtsom gnang ba phal che'i zin bris phyag bris gnang ba la lnga ldan nor bu'i phreng ba/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor/ mos gus gsang ba 'dus pa'i khrid yig

gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i dbang chog 'khor lo bde mchog dang dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs las rim rnams la na bza' bzang pos bsgril ba/ yang spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyi rnam thar bsdus pa bka' brgyud gser phreng rnams la na bza' kha btags kyi byas pa bzhugs shing*/ gsung rab rim par bzhugs pa 'di rnams kyi na bza' dang sku rags thams cad dri bzang gi lde gus byugs/ bar mtshams thams cad rin po che sna tshogs dang*/ sman bzang drug gi thum pos legs par gtams par byas so// yang bum pa'i nang gi phyogs bzhi la/ la phyi chu dbar gyi rten gtso/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i sku dngul gar lugs las grub pa/ thugs khar de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel sran ma 'bring po'i tshad kha dog sna tshogs su yod pa gsum bzhugs pa/ 'bri gung mthil dang*/ rten 'di la phyir bzhugs pa'i bar/ 'od zer kha dog sna lngas rgyun du 'brel ba/ mthil gyi gling nyams chag gi rjes/ zhig gsos mdzad dus/ dngul skus gsung byon/ kho bo 'bri gung mthil gyi rten gyi gtso bor 'gro/ da ltar gyi bla mas thog drangs bu slob tshos bstan pa skyongs gsung ba'i mod 'od zer mthil phyogs la bsdus pa'i sna la sku 'di yang mthil du phebs/ bcu gnyis rin po che nas gdung rgyud na rim gyi 'bral bsrung mdzad/ rjes su gser khang du bzhugs pa/ rag zangs kyi khri rgyab na bza' ber thul sum brtsegs/ sgom zhwa/ bzhugs 'bol/ sku snyes dang bcas pa gcig mnyam med dwags po'i gser sku gsung byon ma na bza' ber thul sum brtsegs sgom zhwa/ bzhugs 'bol sku snyes dang bcas pa sgom pa dbon pos/ dpal ldan sa skyar mthu rgyab pa'i sdig sbyongs su bzhengs pa'i gcung rin po che'i sku dngul gar lugs las grub pa/ sgom zhwa sku chos/ ber thul sum brtsegs/ sku snyes bzhugs gdan khri rgyab dang bcas pa gcig

spyan snga 'bri gung gling pa'i gser sku la/ dbu zhwa/ na bza'/ bzhugs gdan/ khri rgyab dang bcas pa bzhugs/ de'i steng gi chos 'khor bcu gsum nas/ bum pa'i smad yan gyi srog shing la btags pa'i thugs dam thang sku'i bzhugs tshul/ rje rin po che 'di nyid rang gi thugs dam/ dar lcags skya las grub pa dkyus la mtho bcu gnyis/ zheng la mtho brgyad re yod pa'i a tshon mtshon rdzogs kyi dar thang la/ gtso bo rdo rje 'chang la/ til+li nas bzung rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen yan gyi bla ma brgyud pa/ de'i mkhan brgyud yongs su rdzogs pa/ grub chen brgyad/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ gu ru zhi drag sogs bzhugs pa'i gong gsham/ zur rgyan rnams gos ta hun la ldum rtsegs ris yod pa/ zhal khebs dar sman tse/ sgril shing gi dod la/ gos bzang bsgrigs kyi byel phrug kha gsum yod pa gcig bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs/ bde dgyes phyag mang dus 'khor/ gsang 'dus rnams kyi gtso bo byas/ de rnams kyi bla ma brgyud rim dang*/ gong gsham zhal khebs byel phrug kha dang bcas pa gong dang mthun pa gcig gter mgon gtso 'khor phyag bzhi pa gtso 'khor/ beng lcam dral gtso 'khor/ phyag drug pa gtso 'khor rnams dang*/ de'i bla ma brgyud rim dang bcas pa gong gsham zhal khebs/ byel phrug kha dang bcas pa gong dang mthun pa/ a phyi mched lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ a phyi chibs bzhon/ rnam sras/ dam can sde bdun so so'i 'khor dang bcas pa la bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa tshang ba/ zhal khebs gong gsham/ byel phrug kha sogs gong dang mthun pa/ ston pa'i gser thang sangs rgyas sum cu so lngas bskor ba/ gong gsham gos phug ron kha'i steng du/ ta hun gyi me tog gis bkod pa/ dril shing kyang gser gyi lde gu'i skyo 'bur khrid pa/ zhal khebs dar sman tshe/ sog byus sum 'brel dang*/ nyis brtsegs kyi steng du/ dar ta hun gyi byel phrug kha phrob dang bcas pa tshang ba gcig

skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi sku rnam thar phyogs bcu dus gsum ma/ rje dbang gi phyag nas grangs mang ba bzhugs pa/ gong gsham gos dmar smug zhal khebs gan dar ljang khus byas pa gcig skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi sku sham rdo rje gsang lam ma'i steng du/ zhabs rjes bkod pa ma/ rje de nyid kyi sku'i phyag nas brgya rtsa bzhugs pa/ gong gsham gos lcags skya bzang bas byas pa/ zhal khebs gan dar sum rtsegs yod pa gcig yang jo bo rje 'brom ston pa yab sras kyi sku la/ bka' gdams gtso bsdus ma rgyud pas bskor ba/ sprul sku bya yul ba'i phyag nas brgya rtsa bzhugs pa/ gos lcags skya bzang po'i gong gsham zhal khebs gnyis brtsegs yod pa gcig dpal chen rga lo'i thugs dam/ grub chen bir+wa pa'i sku la grub thob brgyad cus bskor ba/ gong gsham nya byus gser ma/ zhal khebs gnyis brtsegs yod pa/ rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags pa/ dpal chen rga lo yab sras gnyis kyi phyag nas brgya rtsa bzhugs pa/ mar me dang me tog rgyun du 'dzin pa/ 'byung po ma rungs pa yod pa'i sar zhal phye ba tsam gyis rgyang ring du skrod nus pa'i ya mtshan mchog tu che ba gcig rnams re re la'ang na bza' gsar pa/ gan dar rgyu bzang ba sgron/ dri bzang gis byugs/ rin po che sna tshogs dang bzang drug gi thum bus gtams te bzhugs/ rigs lnga ser 'jam na bza' la dri bzang gi lde gus byugs/ rin po che sna tshogs dang bzang drug gi thum bus bkang ba gcig byang chub ljon shing las grub pa'i pha dam pa'i sgom stegs bzo spras ma nyams pa gcig la/ gan dar ta hun gyi na bza' dri bzang gi lde gus byugs te/ rin po che sna tshogs dang bzang drug gis thum bus bkang ba gcig kha dog lnga'i dar yug gi srog shing dang sbrags nas dkris pa'i steng du/ rje 'di nyid kyi sku cham skyer kha/ chu dar gyis bsgril te bzhugs/ chos 'khor steng gi yas pad gdugs char khebs sbrags pa'i nang du/

skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi dbu zhwa rgyun du bzhes pa/ zhwa phrug do ma las grub pa'i sgom zhwa de'i nang bzhugs/ yang de 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi sku/ dngul gar blugs las grub pa gcig la na bza' ber thul bcu/ bzhugs gdan/ sku snyes dang bcas pa/ tsan dan dmar po la 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i tsaka li/ mnga' bdag mar pa'i rigs lnga/ na bza' dar dpyangs dang bcas pa/ ti si'i gangs skyems/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i kun+da/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i kun+da/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga'i sku sha'i rdo/ rgya nag gi sin+dhu ra/ yang sin+dhu ra dkar po/ byin rlabs ril bu/ 'phags pa wa ti gnyis kyi sa sna dang rtsi mchog yer pa na jo bo yab sras rngog dang lo chen rin bzang dpon slob zhal 'dzom pa'i dus/ stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yi ge a dkar po che chung 'bring gsum gyis khyab pa'i dbus su/ rdo'i mchod rten rang byon mtheb gang ba tsam bzhugs pa la/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rnams thim rjes su yi ge a rnams kyang thim/ yang yar 'phrang gi yi ge drug pa nas/ mar me gcig la gnyis mched kyi rnam par/ 'od zer sna lnga las grub pa/ bar mtshams med par byung ba yang thim pas mchod rten 'dzam bu gling pa la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ster nus pa de dang*/ ja shing*/ mchod rdzas/ na bza'/ bzhugs gdan dang bcas pa/ yang rje 'di nyid kyi dbu zhwa gos chen gser ma las grub pa'i sgom zhwa/ sde bdag don yod rdo rjes phul ba gcig rnams gos dar bzang po dri ma med pa'i na bza' dang*/ dri bzang gis byugs/ rin po che sna tshogs dang*/ bzang drug gi thum bus yongs su bkang nas bzhugs/ de'i steng nyi zla bya ru'i dbus su/ khri drug 'gyogs/ rgyan rnam bzhi tshang ba'i steng du/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi dngul sku/ rgyu dngul dkar shing srang gi nya ga nyi shu rtsa brgyad la/

bzhu btul lhad 'don legs par byas te/ gar lugs su bzhengs pa'i nang bzhugs bstod kyi cha la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi dbu zhwa/ rje til+li pa nas bde gshegs phag gru pa yan gyi gdung rus/ ring bsrel/ jo bo rje'i dbu lo/ gdung rus/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon nas dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po yan gyi/ 'bri gung pa rang gi gdung rabs gong ma rnams kyi ring bsrel phon che ba/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i 'phel gdung*/ gzhan yang 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyi kun+da/ rje phag gru pa'i 'jag spyil gyi rtsa/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas rdo las grub pa'i 'jam dbyangs rigs lnga'i sku sha/ yang ri bo rtse lnga'i rdo'i mchod rten rang byon/ bal po'i mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi sa/ 'phags pa wa ti'i shing lo/ rgya mtsho bla'i 'jag ma sogs dang*/ gzungs sngags kyi rigs/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i mtshan 'bum/ grub chen brgyad la sogs pa'i mtshan 'bum/ bde dgyes la sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i srog sngags ring thung tshang ba/ shākya mu ne'i gzungs sngags thung ba/ rjes dran/ rigs lnga la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi gzungs sngags cha tshang*/ 'od zer dri ma med pa'i gzung sogs gzungs chen sde lnga/ gdugs dkar/ nor rgyun ma sogs lha mo rnams kyi gzungs sngags cha tshang*/ rab 'byams sna lnga sogs gzungs phan yon can rnams dang*/ ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ gter mgon/ beng*/ gur sogs kyi gzung sngags tshang ba/ rnam sras dzaṃ bha la sogs nor lha rnams kyi gzungs sngags cha tshang ba rnams go rim dang gnas ma log par bzhugs/ 'khor pad kyi nang*/ gnod sbyin bang mdzod du rin po che'i rigs pad+ma rā ga bai ḍūr+ya/ pud pa rā ga gser/ dngul/ g.yu/ mu tig byu ru/ spos shel/ mchong*/ dung*/ shel dkar/ mu men sogs sna tshogs pa/ tsan dan/ ga pur/ dzā ti sogs bzang drug sman gyi bye brag dang*/

'bras/ nas dkar sogs 'bru'i rigs dang*/ ka ra/ bu ram sogs rtsi bcud du ma dang*/ rgun 'brum star kha sogs shing thog dang 'bras bu'i rigs tshang ba/ gos/ zi hung*/ la jus/ ling sogs rgya hor gyi gos dar gyi na bza' dang bcas te bzhugs pa'i bar mtshams rnams ni rin po che rnams bdar ba'i phye ma'i phur ma/ dri bzang pos byugs te bzhugs so// rten 'di nyid kyi lugs 'debs pa'i snga nub na/ sprul sku rdo rje rgyal po'i rmang lam du/ nam mkha'i mthongs su rten med par/ spyan snga rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen pa 'di nyid sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ gur gum ku sha ris kyi chos gos sum rtsegs dang ldan pa/ ta huṃ gser ma'i sgom zhwa gsol ba/ phyag na tshe bum bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa la/ 'khor gur gum ku sha ris kyi sku chos dang na bza' gsol ba/ dbu reg zhabs rjen mdzad pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong*/ g.yon pas kha dog lnga'i gdugs bsnams pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyis bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad gsung zhing*/ ya mtshan mchog tu gyur pa'i rten 'di ma grub kyi bar du/ bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi/ gsungs pa'i sgra dang bcas pa'i mod la rmang lam sad de/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon dngos kyi phyag nas mdzad pa'i mos gus dang*/ yid ches pa thob par 'dug rten 'di la rab tu gnas pa/ dbyar chos chen mo dang dus mtshungs pas/ rje 'di nyid rang gi sta gon gyi cho ga gnang*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu bu chen grangs mang bas thogs drangs/ tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bus me tog 'thor ba'i dus/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang*/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i me tog char 'beb pa/ phyogs thams cad dri bzang gis khyab pa la sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas ni bsam las 'das pa'o// gzhan yang rab gnas dngos gzhi'i dus na ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can ches mang po/ rtsod med du byung ba ji snyed pa bri bas mi lang la/

mdo tsam zhig dkar chag chen mo na'ang 'khod cing*/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las lhun grub tu byung ba ni/ skye bo thams cad kyis mngon sum yin la/ lhag par rgyal ba'i bstan pa la phyin ci log tu gzhol ba'i lta ba ngan pa sde dang bcas pa rnams/ drag po'i las la mnga' bsgyur ba'i dpal ye shes kyi mgon po/ chos bdag a phyi 'khor dang bcas pas tshar bcad de yang dag pa'i bstan pa la rnal du 'god par mdzad pa yang*/ yul ljongs kyi skye bo mtha' dag gi mngon du grub ste/ shing bya zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes la rab gnas mdzad par mngon du phyogs pa'i zla ba bdun pa'i nyer dgu'i nyin/ pha rol log pa'i sde/ log 'dren gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i skyid shod pa'i dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi dang bcas pas/ khang thog gi nang dbyen du las kyis bskul nas lhag pa de'i tshe/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos nges par byin gyis brlabs shing*/ dpa' mdzangs brtul phod dang ldan pa'i mgon rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa'ang*/ brgya byin nye dbang dang bcas pa/ lha min gyi steng gi bar snang la chas pa ltar/ g.yul ngor bdar ba na/ a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma/ mkha' 'gro'i chas kyi mda' dar g.yob bzhin par chibs kyi steng nas/ nam mkha' khyab pa'i sku lus can/ sha za mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor bzhin pa/ dbon mgon rgyal gyi dpung gi ru 'dren lta bu'i tshul du byon song ba/ lha mig rjes mthun pa yod pa'i byis pa/ lo sor zhes bya bas mngon sum du mthong nas pha ma dang grogs la smras pa yul de dus kyi skye bos mngon sum du grub la/ dmag dpung gi gdong nas 'brug char gyis bsus shing*/ dmag dpon gyi ral gri las khrag zags pa'i mtshan ma ni deng sang yang bltar yod cing*/ skyid shod pa'i dmag mi rnams 'di bya'i gtol cang med par myos pa'i rjes su/ go mtshon chas rkyen cung zad kyang ma lus pa dbon mgon rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa la phul zhing*/

so so la srog gi mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs byin pas/ thams cad lus la rma srol tsam yang med par bde ba'i dbugs phyin pas/ dbon mgon rgyal dpa' mdzangs kyi grags pas 'dzam bu'i gling khyab par ma zad/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar du mngon te/ ji skad du/ g.yul bshams dang*// mtshon brtsams pas rgyal gnod pa med// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// de nas dwags po bka' brgyud rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i bstan pa dkar 'jam du mdzad de/ de dag gi bar bar na yang pha rol gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa mtha' dag rim gyis zhi ba yang*/ skyob pa nyid kyi byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ thugs rje'i mdzad pa dang*/ rten mchog gi byin rlabs las/ bdag cag rnams kyis yid ches par gyur te/ mdor na phrin las rnam bzhis thub bstan rgyas par mdzad pa'o// de ltar brjod pa'ang*/ brjod byang mdo tsam bkod kyi/ ngo mtshar phun tshogs 'bri bar 'os pa shin tu mang ba mtshon nas/ bka' drin dran te rjes su yi rang bar rigs so// bdag dang 'khor 'das dus gsum gyi// dge dang yod pa'i dge ba yis// bdag dang 'gro kun myur du ni// bla med byang chub thob par shog /dkar chag rgyas 'bring shin tu rgyas// thog mtha' bar dge'i rgyan gyis spras// bla ma mchog la mchod par 'bul// phrin las rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// de ltar sbyar bas bla ma dang*// bka' srung thams cad mnyes gyur nas// bshad dang sgrub pas thub bstan ni// lang tsho nyid du byed par shog /'phrog byed rkang pa'i dug gis ni// sbags pa'i gsar chos lam gsum can// bdud rtsir rloms pa'i phyi rabs pa// thams cad chos kyis pham byed shog /dkar chag dngul dkar me long la// rten mchog ngo mtshar gzugs brnyan rnams// gsal por shar bas mkhas rnams dang*// dad ldan dga' ba bskyed par shog /sdom gsum dpag bsam phrag dog gi /'khris shing 'jam bus ma bcings par// mkhas pa'i dri mdangs kun khyab pas// bstan 'dzin rkang drug 'du bar shog

/bzang po'i nyams rtogs lo 'bras can// rtse mo mkha' la reg par shog /de ltar mkhas btsun bzang po yi// pad steng nyi ma zla ba'i steng*// phrin las rin chen khri 'phang la// dpal ldan bla ma zhabs brtan shog /
